title: BUGFIX — /posted auto-detect picks last delivery (already posted), not last UNPOSTED
rationale: cmdPosted() reads the last line of auto-delivered.jsonl to auto-detect the video. But the last delivery (dbt-c9a1b9aa) is already recorded — operator gets 'already recorded' error. Fix: scan auto-delivered.jsonl from the end, skip entries already in manual-posts.jsonl, use the first unposted one.

tasks.description: In scripts/telegram-commands/cmd-content.ts, change cmdPosted() to scan auto-delivered.jsonl from the end and skip video_ids already in readRealPosts(). Use the first unposted entry found instead of the last line blindly.
